_about: The offer a proposal prints, and the options a closer picks for each one.
Aziz edits this file; the drafter's prompt and the validator both read it, so a change here changes both on the next draft.
Money is whole US dollars. A proposal request may override price and months; everything else comes from here.
Anything carrying a 'confirm' line is a default written by the engineer, waiting for Aziz to confirm.

guarantee.label: Include the 7-day satisfaction guarantee
guarantee.text: A 7-day satisfaction guarantee: if you are unhappy with the process in any way in your first 7 days, tell us and we refund you.
guarantee.source: Aziz, 2026-10-02: "it's a 7-day satisfaction guarantee. If they're unhappy with the process whatsoever in the first 7 days, then we'll just refund them", and "we legally can't give them a result guarantee because everybody's different". HighLevel has the contract for it: 90 Day Agreement (7 Day Satisfaction Guarantee). It replaced 30 qualified appointments in 90 days or we work for free.
guarantee.confirm: Printed only when the closer chooses it, because it is offered only to a prospect who asked for certainty; a request that does not say is taken as no guarantee. It is on the process, never on results: no proposal promises results, free work or a number of meetings, whatever the closer chose. {meetings}, {days} and {months} would be filled in from the program and the closer's choice.

pif.label: Paid in full at the start

two_payments.label: Two payments
two_payments.confirm: Aziz to confirm: half at the start, half 45 days in.

monthly.label: Monthly across the term
monthly.confirm: Aziz to confirm: one equal payment a month, the first at the start.

pitch._about: The funnel arithmetic quoted on every call at the agreed advertising budget (PATTERNS.md).
